name: travel-crm-root
description: TravelCRM Pro — Multi-tenant Tours & Travels SaaS CRM

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n api,desktop -c blue,green "npm -w travelcrm-api run dev" "npm -w travelcrm-desktop run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:desktop: npm -w @travelcrm/shared run build && npm -w travelcrm-desktop run build
scripts.infra:plan: cd terraform && terraform init -input=false && terraform plan
scripts.typecheck: npm -w travelcrm-api run typecheck && npm -w travelcrm-desktop run typecheck
scripts.analyze: cd packages/shared && dart analyze && cd ../driver_app && dart analyze
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:flutter
scripts.setup: npm install && melos bootstrap && npm run dev:codegen
scripts.clean: melos run clean && node -e "for (const d of ['backend/node_modules','super-admin/node_modules','super-admin/.next','super-admin/.open-next','desktop/node_modules','desktop/.next']) require('fs').rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})"
